basic_info.name: MuQ (SSL music foundation model) and MuQ-MuLan (music-text joint embedding model). Variants: MuQ-m4a (Music4all pre-trained), MuQ (160K-hour in-house), MuQ_iter (iterative refinement); MuQ-MuLan-large on HF.
basic_info.org: Tencent AI Lab, with X-LANCE Lab (Shanghai Jiao Tong University) and Nanjing University. Authors: Haina Zhu, Yizhi Zhou, Hangting Chen, Jianwei Yu, Ziyang Ma, Rongzhi Gu, Yi Luo, Wei Tan, Xie Chen.
basic_info.release_date: arXiv 2501.01108 posted 2025-01-02 (v2 2025-01-03); HF checkpoints (OpenMuQ) released with the repo in early 2025.

architecture.backbone: MuQ: 12-layer Conformer (~310M params) over 128-band Mel spectrograms pooled to 25 Hz; SSL target tokens come from Mel-RVQ (8 codebooks x 1024, single-linear-layer encoder/decoder, trained on music). MuQ-MuLan: two-tower music-text model = frozen-init MuQ music encoder (temporal mean-pool + linear projection) + XLM-RoBERTa-base text encoder plus 8 extra Transformer layers; total ~630M params (repo rounds to ~700M).
architecture.input_modality: MuQ: audio only. MuQ-MuLan: audio + text (descriptions of genre, mood, instrument, tempo, keywords).
architecture.training_objective: MuQ: masked language modeling (mask probability 0.6) predicting Mel-RVQ tokens per codebook via per-codebook linear heads with cross-entropy; iterative refinement re-derives Mel-RVQ_iter from the layer-10 latent of the first MuQ and retrains. MuQ-MuLan: decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) over (music, text) pairs, unfrozen encoders, 10 s audio crops, batch 768.
architecture.embedding_output: MuQ-MuLan: 512-d shared music/text embedding space (d=512), global (temporal mean-pooled), single vector per clip; L2-normalized cosine/dot-product retrieval. MuQ (SSL model) itself outputs 1024-d frame-level hidden states (24 layers) for linear probing / downstream aggregation.

data.training_data: SSL: Music4all (0.9K h, open access) for MuQ-m4a; ~160K h in-house music for the scaled MuQ (iterative stage included; open HF checkpoint was instead trained on Million Song Dataset audio). Contrastive: ~130K h in-house (music, text) pairs with genre/mood/instrument/tempo/keyword descriptions, no personal info. Mel-RVQ trained on Music4all. Data licenses not disclosed; in-house portions not public.

performance.benchmarks: Embedding-family MARBLE suite (linear probes, 9 tasks): MuQ_iter avg 77.0 vs MusicFM 75.4 and MERT-v1-330M 74.4; MuQ avg 76.7. Per-task highlights: GTZAN genre 85.6 acc, Giantsteps key 65.0 refined, VocalSet singer 76.1, vocal technique 96.2, MTT tagging ROC-AUC 91.4, Nsynth instrument 79.7 acc. Zero-shot tagging (MagnaTagATune, MusCALL prompt 'A <label> track'): MuQ-MuLan ROC-AUC 79.3 / PR-AUC 29.3 — SOTA at release. Not evaluated on MuChoMusic/MusicBench/Song Describer (LLM-family suites) or GTZAN zero-shot tagging in the paper.
performance.vs_clap: Same MagnaTagATune zero-shot protocol: MuQ-MuLan 79.3 ROC-AUC / 29.3 PR-AUC vs LAION-CLAP (larger_clap_music_and_speech) 73.9 / 25.0, Microsoft-CLAP 2023 75.9 / 28.9, closed MuLan 78.2 (from paper; MuLan used 370K h vs MuQ-MuLan 130K h). Ablations with identical contrastive setups: MERT-MuLan 75.5 / 24.6, MusicFM-MuLan 76.2 / 27.1 — MuQ init gives the gain, not the contrastive recipe.

availability.license: Model weights CC-BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial; production use blocked without separate licensing). Repo code MIT. Requires torch/transformers (fairseq-style Conformer) — not pure-numpy.

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: 24 kHz strictly required (both MuQ and MuQ-MuLan); repo standard is 48 kHz mono so a resample step is needed. fp32 recommended to avoid NaNs.
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: ~630M params total (2.5-2.65 GB fp32). Paper used GPUs for training; inference on CPU is feasible but slow for a library-scale index [uncertain]; official examples assume CUDA.
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: 10 s crops during contrastive training (30 s during SSL pre-training); no native long-context — full tracks need windowed inference plus aggregation (mean/p90 + re-normalization).
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: MuQ SSL backbone gives 25 Hz frame-level hidden states usable for section-level logic; MuQ-MuLan output is global-only (mean-pooled).
fit_for_local_playlist.multilingual_queries: English and Chinese text queries (XLM-R text tower).
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: Standard joint-embedding retrieval only; no built-in attribute control. Follow-up Sparse Steerable Retrieval (ISMIR 2026) builds SAE concept sliders on MuQ-MuLan embeddings, which is the steering path.

uncertain: Exact data license of the 160K h in-house SSL set and 130K h contrastive set (not disclosed)
